body:
## Pull request overview

Extracts the `calendar-view` complex UI component out of `@object-ui/components` into a dedicated plugin package, aligning the core components library with the “Shadcn primitives only” goal.

**Changes:**
- Added new package `@object-ui/plugin-calendar-view` (component implementation + ObjectUI renderer + build config).
- Removed `calendar-view` exports/registration and its registration tests from `@object-ui/components`.
- Updated `shadcn-components.json` metadata to mark extracted components as moved-to-plugin.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 10 out of 11 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Adds lock entries for the new `@object-ui/plugin-calendar-view` workspace package. |
| packages/plugin-calendar-view/package.json | Defines the new plugin package metadata, deps, and build scripts. |
| packages/plugin-calendar-view/tsconfig.json | TS config for building type declarations for the plugin. |
| packages/plugin-calendar-view/vite.config.ts | Vite lib build config for the plugin bundle/types output. |
| packages/plugin-calendar-view/src/index.tsx | CalendarView component implementation relocated into the plugin. |
| packages/plugin-calendar-view/src/renderer.tsx | Registers `calendar-view` in `ComponentRegistry` for schema rendering. |
| packages/plugin-calendar-view/README.md | Adds basic install/usage docs for the new plugin. |
| packages/components/src/ui/index.ts | Removes `calendar-view` export from core UI primitives barrel. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/complex/index.ts | Stops registering `calendar-view` from core complex renderers. |
| packages/components/src/__tests__/complex-disclosure-renderers.test.tsx | Removes core registration/render smoke tests for `calendar-view`. |
| packages/components/shadcn-components.json | Annotates `calendar-view` (and related items) as moved to plugin packages. |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>

<details>
<summary>Comments suppressed due to low confidence (2)</summary>

**packages/plugin-calendar-view/src/renderer.tsx:114**
* `CalendarViewSchema` from `@object-ui/types` is defined around an `events` array plus `date/defaultDate`, `editable`, etc. This renderer still appears to build `events` from `schema.data`/`titleField`/`startDateField` (earlier in the file) and uses `currentDate`/`allowCreate`/`onDateClick` which aren’t part of the typed schema. That means schema usage providing `events` (as in the previous core tests) will silently render an empty calendar. Please align the renderer to the `CalendarViewSchema` contract (or update `@object-ui/types` + zod schema if the contract intentionally changed).
**packages/plugin-calendar-view/src/renderer.tsx:106**
* `validView` is narrowed via a type assertion (`schema.view as ...`), which undermines the stated goal of “no type assertions” and still leaves the value unchecked at the type level. Prefer a small type-guard helper (e.g., `isSupportedView(v): v is 'month'|'week'|'day'`) so the narrowing is both runtime-validated and compile-time safe without casts.
</details>

This PR removes the existing registration/render smoke tests for `calendar-view`, but the extracted plugin package doesn’t appear to add replacement coverage. Since this is a large/complex component+renderer, consider adding at least a minimal test in `@object-ui/plugin-calendar-view` to assert the ComponentRegistry registration and basic render with a simple schema.
